statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Evidence verifies only the explicit stated case/scope, not universal or biological acceptance.
statusDefinitions.INTEGRATED: Authentic source is connected at the stated scope; further validation or option exposure remains.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Specific current resource or compatibility limitation.
statusDefinitions.UNAVAILABLE: Not connected/usable through the current native adapter.

features.name: upstream filter/rank commands

features.name: campaign recovery

features.name: autotuning and desperation

features.name: offline bundled core runtimes and models

features.name: all settings/preset hierarchies
